title: 第332章 你们人多欺负人少第331章 他是纯小白
content_zh:
第332章你们人多欺负人少！
“我胡说？”陆青山抬手指着他的脸，半点面子都不给。
“那你倒是说说，这张脸是怎么回事？”
“可别告诉老夫，是你自己摔的。”
纯小白下意识摸了摸脸。
手指才刚碰到腮帮子，一阵钻心的疼痛便窜了上来，疼得他“嗷”的一叫。
可下一刻，他便挺直腰杆，理直气壮地道：
“没错，本大王就是摔的！”
“……”
屋里顿时安静下来。
方元、白玉堂和白锦儿全都愣愣地看着他。
这瞎话说得，眼睛都不带眨一下。
谁家摔跤专挑脸摔？
纯小白也没办法。
总不能说自己被几个不是人的东西围起来打的吧？
那岂不是更丢人！
“行了，行了，别在意这些外表。”纯小白摆了摆手，强行岔开话题。
“本大王有多大本事，你们又不是不知道。”
说着，他从怀里抓出一大把储物戒指，抬手拍在桌上。
啪！

“整整一百亿灵石！全部到手！”
“切，才一百亿。”陆青山撇了撇嘴，一脸不屑。
这语气听得纯小白一愣，随即瞪起眼睛，“才一百亿？”
“你这老杂毛站着说话不腰疼是吧？一百亿你还嫌少！”
白锦儿见势不对，赶忙拉了拉纯小白的衣袖。
“大王，大王。”
“之前万花宗宗主王鸾来过一趟，直接送了两百亿灵石，说是给我们的茶钱。”
“啥？！”纯小白猛地转过头，盯着白锦儿看了半晌，那张猪头脸一阵青、一阵白。
“你妹的！”
纯小白嘴角抽了半天，心里越想越不是滋味。
本大王把脑袋别在裤腰带上，才赚回来区区一百亿，他们几个坐在这里喝喝茶，两百亿就到手了？”
这世道太他娘不公平了！
content_en:
Chapter 332: There are many of you and you bully the few!
"Am I talking nonsense?" Lu Qingshan raised his finger and pointed at his face, not giving him any face.
"Then tell me, what's going on with this face?"
"Don't tell me, you dropped it yourself."
Chun Xiaobai subconsciously touched his face.
As soon as his fingers touched his cheek, a heartbreaking pain rushed up, making him scream out in pain.
But the next moment, he straightened his back and said confidently:
"That's right, this king fell down!"
"..."
The room suddenly became quiet.
Fang Yuan, Bai Yutang and Bai Jin'er all looked at him blankly.
You can tell this nonsense without blinking an eye.
Whose wrestling specializes in face wrestling?
There is nothing a pure novice can do.
You can't say that you were surrounded and beaten by several non-human beings, right?
Wouldn't that be even more embarrassing!
"Okay, okay, don't worry about these appearances." Chun Xiaobai waved his hand and forcibly changed the topic.
"It's not like you don't know how capable this king is."
As he spoke, he grabbed a handful of storage rings from his arms, raised his hand and slapped it on the table.
Snap!
"Ten billion spiritual stones! Get them all!"
"Yeah, it's only 10 billion." Lu Qingshan curled his lips with disdain on his face.
Chun Xiaobai was startled by this tone, and then opened his eyes, "Only 10 billion?"
"You old bastard doesn't feel pain in your back when you stand and talk, right? Ten billion is not enough for you!"
Seeing that something was wrong, Bai Jin'er hurriedly pulled Chun Xiaobai's sleeves.
"Your Majesty, Your Majesty."
"Wang Luan, the leader of the Wanhua Sect, came here before and gave us 20 billion spiritual stones, saying it was tea money for us."
"What?!" Chun Xiaobai turned his head suddenly and stared at Bai Jin'er for a long time. His pig-headed face turned green and white.
"Your sister!"
Chun Xiaobai's mouth twitched for a long time, and the more he thought about it, the more uncomfortable he felt.
This king only made a mere 10 billion with his head tucked into his waistband. The few of them sit here drinking tea and get 20 billion? "
This world is so damn unfair!
